title: albuca seineri

It is traditionally used in African and Asian folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, as well as its ability to alleviate respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Albuca seineri include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins.
